help:
usage: pctk [-h] [--version]
            {deid-dicom,deid-image,deid-frame,srb,compliance,ingest-formf,biometry,backends,planes-demo,planes-train,planes-eval,planes-predict,health-demo,health-train,health-predict} ...

Prenatal-care toolkit (de-id, SRB, PCPNDT compliance, biometry).

positional arguments:
  {deid-dicom,deid-image,deid-frame,srb,compliance,ingest-formf,biometry,backends,planes-demo,planes-train,planes-eval,planes-predict,health-demo,health-train,health-predict}
    deid-dicom          de-identify DICOM header
    deid-image          redact burned-in text in an image
    deid-frame          DICOM frame -> redacted image
    srb                 sex-ratio-at-birth anomaly report
    compliance          PCPNDT Form-F audit
    ingest-formf        extract a Form F from a PDF/image into a record
    biometry            gestational age / fetal weight
    backends            list available OCR backends
    planes-demo         synthetic end-to-end train+eval of the plane model
    planes-train        train plane model on FETAL_PLANES_DB
    planes-eval         evaluate a saved plane model
    planes-predict      classify one ultrasound frame
    health-demo         synthetic end-to-end train+eval of the CTG model
    health-train        train CTG model on a fetal-health CSV
    health-predict      classify one CTG record (JSON)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             print version and exit
